  COMMENTS OF HUT 8 CORP ON STAFF’S PROPOSAL FOR PUBLICATION OF NEW 16
                               TAC §25.194

        COMES NOW Hut 8 Corp (Hut 8) and files these comments regarding Commission Staff's

Proposal for Publication (PFP) of new 16 Texas Administrative Code (TAC) §25.194 relating to Large

Load Interconnection Standards, which would set forth the standards and criteria for an electric utility to

interconnect a large load customer to the ERCOT transmission network. The Commission is expected to

consider the PFP at its March 12, 2026, Open Meeting. Hut 8 has concerns that Staff's proposal will obstruct

development of large load projects and respectfully requests that the Commission consider changes to the

PFP prior to formal publication for comment under the Administrative Procedure Act.

        Hut 8 suggests the following changes to the Proposal for Publication:

        1. Batch Zero should include as base load not subject to demand re-evaluation projects that have

            already signed an agreement with the utility and have satisfied all CIAC and security payment

            obligations prior to July 15, 2026.

        2. Adding the following sentence to the end of section (a) of the Proposal for Publication (page 7

            of 30): “Any projects that have executed a signed agreement with the TSP prior to the effective

            date of this rule and have satisfied all CIAC and security payment obligations in accordance

            with the timelines specified in that agreement by the effective date of this rule shall be exempt

            from additional costs or security required by the following standards.”




                                                     1
                                            CONCLUSION

       Hut 8 appreciates the opportunity to submit these comments and encourages the Commission to

move to formal publication of a proposed rule with modifications consistent with these comments.


Date: March 11, 2026



                                               Respectfully submitted,

                                               /s/ Casey Bell
